files.name: input.txt
files.description: Deterministic input file generated by gen_inputs_script containing several lines, some with the marker MARKER.

files.name: result.txt
files.description: Output file produced by the evaluation script listing only lines containing MARKER, in the same order as input.txt.

properties.marker_presence: There must be at least one line containing MARKER in input.txt to validate extraction.
properties.result_content_verification: result.txt must contain exactly the lines from input.txt that include MARKER, preserving line order and content.
properties.determinism: gen_inputs_script must deterministically generate input.txt using fixed seeds.
properties.robustness: eval_script should gracefully handle missing files and minor formatting differences (case-insensitive marker, whitespace).
